title: Correction to: Early-life exposure to PM2.5 and risk of acute asthma clinical encounters among children in Massachusetts: a case-crossover analysis.
ehr_evidence: This manuscript is a correction notice to a previously published study and does not describe the primary data source.
summary: Correction notice addressing an incorrect demographic count in Table 1 of a previously published case-crossover study on early-life PM2.5 exposure and acute asthma clinical encounters in Massachusetts.
